events.title: Wild Wonders Nature Club
events.description:
Through hands-on experiences and creative projects, we aim to inspire the next generation of nature enthusiasts and environmental stewards. This program is for children ages 6 to 10.

We won’t always go outside, but on the days that we do, kids need to dress appropriately for the weather. It’s also helpful to have a nature journal to keep track of all the fun things they will learn!

events.title: Sip & Stitch
events.description: Bring your current craft project (knit, crochet, quilt, whatever), and enjoy time with other creators. All levels and types of crafters are welcome!

events.title: Homeschool Teen Hangout
events.description: In this monthly afternoon program, teens can play board games, video games, or just hang out! The Library has a Wii and plenty of board games. Teens are welcome to bring Nintendo Switches. Snacks will be provided. Ages 12-18

events.title: Fridays at the Library Book Club
events.description:
Join us for a NEW book club every third Friday from 2:00-3:00 p.m where we will discuss newer titles! The first meeting will be on Friday, 9/18 to choose the beginning title.
For any questions, email director@sheplibrary.org

events.title: Gentle Mat Yoga w/ Dee Marshall
events.description:
Join yoga instructor Dee Marshall for gentle mat yoga with props every third Saturday of the month from 10:30-11:30 a.m.

Bring your own yoga mat if possible. First session is on 10/17.

events.title: Lego Club
events.description: Come to the monthly Lego Club for fun and creativity with the library’s extensive Lego collection!  There will also be Duplos on the carpet for the little ones. Best for ages 3+

events.title: QiGong Class
events.description: The meditative movement QiGong will be taught and lead at the library by Chuck Steg. QiGong is a Chinese practice that involves movement, breathing, and meditation to improve health and wellbeing. Beginners are welcome. This class is free and requires no registration. This class will meeting every Monday at 9 a.m. in the library’s Commons Room. Should class be canceled for some reason, we will announce it on the homepage of our website and on social media as soon as we are alerted.

events.title: Adaptive Chair Yoga with Dee Marshall
events.description:
Join us for Adaptive Chair Yoga, a gentle and accessible yoga practice designed for all abilities. This class offers the benefits of yoga—including improved flexibility, balance, and relaxation—while using a chair for support. Whether you’re looking to reduce stress, increase mobility, or explore mindful movement in a comfortable way, this class provides a welcoming space to nurture both body and mind. No prior yoga experience is needed.

This class is held on Mondays from 10:30 – 11:30 AM.

events.title: Senior Planet: Getting to Know your IPhone
events.description:
Join on Monday, 10/19 from 1:30-3:00 PM for Getting to Know your IPhone Workshop! Learn about smartphone anatomy, features, iPhone apps, and IOS accessibility.

Registration is REQUIRED. Register HERE

events.title: Art Club for Middle & High Schoolers
events.description: This relaxed, drop-in club for Middle and High Schooler explores a different art medium each week. Mediums include collage, acrylic paint, clay, watercolors, and more! Welcome ages 11-18.

events.title: Middle School Math Club
events.description:
Join the competition math program at the Shepherdstown Public Library on Mondays from 4:30-5:30 PM! Participants will learn strategies to complete challenging math problems and can compete in the National Math Club Competition in April. 6th-8th graders welcome.

Registration is REQUIRED. Email rachel@sheplibrary.org to register!

Sept. 14 – May 10

events.title: Social Seniors Leisure Lounge
events.description: Stop by the library 9AM – 12PM on Tuesday for the Social Seniors Leisure Lounge and enjoy coffee and conversation with friends and neighbors! Make new friends, find out what’s happening locally, and enjoy the company of your community.

events.title: Toddler Story Time
events.description: Ms. Jessie will lead our youngest patrons on adventures through songs, rhymes, stories and socializing. Best for ages 0 – 2.

events.title: STEM Club
events.description:
Our STEM Club for students offers hands-on activities and projects to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics in a fun and interactive way.

Best for Ages 5 – 10. Parents should remain in the Children’s department while their child participates.

events.title: Socrates Cafe
events.description: A Socrates Cafe is a gathering where individuals engage in philosophical discussions using the Socratic method, fostering open dialogue and critical thinking on various topics. These meetings, inspired by the practices of the ancient Greek philosopher Socrates, aim to create a space for participants to explore profound questions and diverse perspectives in a respectful and thought-provoking environment.

events.title: Pre-School Story Time
events.description: Ms. Jessie will lead our youngest patrons on adventures through songs, rhymes, stories and socializing. Best for pre-schoolers ages 3 – 5.

events.title: Meditation
events.description: Explore secular mindfulness and meditation with Kath Meadows of Moving Mountains Yoga. Each session will include guided meditation, mindfulness topics, and time for discussion. All levels welcome. No experience required. This is a free program. For ages 18 and up. Meets in the Library Commons Room.

events.title: Youth Chess Club
events.description:
Join us for a youth chess club where kids & teens can learn, play, and have fun while improving their chess skills in a friendly environment.

Ages 6 -18. Parents of children 6 – 10 years should plan to remain in the Children’s Dept. while their child participates.

events.title: “All Booked Up” No Pressure Book Club
events.description: All Booked Up is a space for busy parents who love to read but don’t have time for traditional book clubs. Instead of assigned books, we share what we are currently reading, swap recommendations, and connect over our love of stories–all at our own pace. No pressure, just great conversations and inspiration!

events.title: Youth Coding Session 2
events.description:
In this weekly, 5-week class, participants will learn the basics of text coding, including an introduction to Python! This session starts on 10/7 and runs through 11/4. Welcome ages 8-15.

Registration is REQUIRED. Complete the form to register: https://forms.gle/WdY6CE1EqW7M5VAy5

events.title: Writers Cafe
events.description: Stop by for the writers cafe every Thursday from 10:00-11:00 a.m.! The writing time is for you, whether you are a beginner or a seasoned writer. Prompts will be provided if you get stuck or need ideas to get started. This is an independent work session: no feedback, no instruction, no sharing, simply a gathering of fellow writers in various stages sitting down to do the work.

events.title: Sensory-Friendly Calm Time – Children’s Library
events.description: Sensory-Friendly Library Time: A calm browsing experience for neurodivergent visitors and those with sensory needs. During this dedicated hour, we create a low-stimulus environment with dimmed lighting and reduced noise. All are welcome to join us in maintaining a peaceful atmosphere from 10 AM – to 11 AM.

events.title: Dementia Caregivers Support Group
events.description: Dementia Caregivers Support Group – Join us for a supportive and understanding space to share experiences, find resources, and connect with others caring for loved ones with dementia. You are not alone on this journey. 💙

events.title: Legacy & Planned Giving: The Whys and Hows
events.description:
The Shepherdstown Public Library Foundation is hosting an information session on legacy and planned giving on Thursday, October 22nd, 2:30-4:00 p.m. at the library.
Presenters include Alison A. Cox, Esq., Bowles Rice LLP and Archie Hoxton, MS, CFP, Partner/ Advisor at Hoxton Planning and Management

events.title: Crafternoon
events.description:
Join us for a craft program for kids where they can make fun art projects and learn new skills with something new every week!

Best for Ages 5 – 10. Parents are asked to remain in the Children’s Department with their participating child.

events.title: Sip & Stitch
events.description: Bring your current craft project (knit, crochet, quilt, whatever), and enjoy time with other creators. All levels and types of crafters are welcome!

events.title: Halloween Storytime at the Plaza
events.description:
Join Miss Jessie on Saturday, October 24th at 11:00 a.m. at The Market House Plaza for a Halloween storytime filled with not-too-spooky stories, songs, and fun!
Children of all ages are welcome, and costumes are encouraged. Bring the whole family and get ready for a frightfully good time!

events.description:
For the month of October, we are excited to host the astonishing work of artist Hilary Schenker. Hilary is a landscape oil painter based out of Takoma Park, MD. Join us Thursday, October 29th for a meet the artist opportunity from 5:00-7:00 PM.

events.title: Beekeeping for Beginners
events.description:
Join Jason Murphy of Hive House Apiaries every Monday in November from 6:30-8:30 PM for Beekeeping for Beginners Class Series.
Registration is REQUIRED. Email hivehouse@hotmail.com to register.

events.title: Marie Botsford: Giving Back Through Art
events.description:
Join us in November (3rd-30th) for a solo exhibition and sale of acrylic and watercolor paintings by local artist Marie Botsford.

Get a chance to meet Marie Botsford on November 7th from 3:00-5:00 p.m.

100% of all sales will go to the library.
